notablePrerequisites: Synthesizer Labship has nine or more charge counters on it.
easyPrerequisites: You are able to animate the land.
description:
Animate the land, if needed.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Synthesizer Labship triggers, animating Lost Jitte.
Activate Marvin using Synthesizer Labship's station ability by tapping the animated land, putting a number of charge counters on Marvin equal to the animated land's power.
Activate Marvin using Lost Jitte's ability by removing a charge counter from it, untapping the animated land.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.name: Lost Jitte
uses.cardState: is not attached to a creature
